Enterprise SaaS · Cybersecurity · Compliance

Phishing Simulation Platform

LRN Technologies · Sept 2023 – Nov 2025

RoleUX Consultant — Outsourced
PlatformEnterprise Web SaaS
IndustryCybersecurity · Compliance
Project Type0 → 1 Product Design
Discovery & Research

The Problem

LRN's compliance training suite lacked a native phishing simulation capability. Security teams were managing campaigns manually across disconnected tools — with no unified analytics, no reusable template library, and no mechanism to close the loop between a failed simulation and remediation training.

!No centralised platform for launching, managing, and tracking phishing simulations
!Campaign configuration required multiple disconnected tools and manual CSV exports
!No reusable template system — every campaign built from scratch by security teams
!Reporting buried in raw data exports with no actionable risk scoring or trend view
!No direct connection between simulation failures and LRN's remediation training modules

Objective

Design a purpose-built phishing simulation platform that integrates natively into LRN's compliance ecosystem — enabling security teams to launch campaigns, monitor real-time engagement, identify at-risk employees, and automatically assign remediation training. The experience must be fast, governance-ready, and measurably reduce the time-to-campaign from days to minutes.

Design Goals

✓Campaign creation in under 5 minutes for security admins
✓Real-time risk scores surfaced at individual and team level
✓Reusable template library reducing campaign setup overhead
✓Closed-loop: failure → training assignment automated
✓WCAG 2.1 AA accessible, GDPR-compliant data handling
Discovery
Definition
Wireframes
Visual Design
Handoff & Iterate
Methodology

End-to-end engagement from discovery through post-launch iteration — working in cross-functional sprints with Product, Engineering, and the Security Advisory team across 6 defined design phases.

›

3 post-launch review cycles refining dashboard, template UX, and reporting flows

Outcomes

Design Impact

9
Core Surfaces
5 min
Campaign Setup Target
3
Post-launch Iterations
AA
WCAG Compliance

Reduced Campaign Friction

The simplified multi-step campaign builder — target selection, template, schedule, confirm — eliminated the manual overhead that previously required security teams to coordinate across multiple tools. Campaign setup time dropped significantly from the baseline.

Actionable Risk Visibility

By translating raw click and report data into individual and departmental risk scores surfaced on the dashboard, security teams gained an at-a-glance posture indicator they could act on immediately — rather than manually deriving signals from export files.

Closed-Loop Remediation

The automatic training assignment triggered on simulation failure created a direct, measurable connection between awareness gap and remediation — the key missing link between the simulation product and LRN's broader compliance learning ecosystem.

“Designing for enterprise security workflows meant balancing the urgency of real-world threat simulation with the administrative needs of teams managing compliance at scale — every interaction had to earn its place.”

Abhishek Patade — UX Consultant, LRN Technologies

Edumentr

Student Mobility & Services Platform · iOS & Android

RoleUX Consultant — Outsourced
PlatformiOS & Android
DomainEdTech / Study Abroad
DeliverableEnd-to-end Mobile App

The Problem

Students pursuing international education navigate a fragmented landscape — dozens of university portals, scattered eligibility criteria, and manual document checklists with no single place to compare, apply, and track. The cognitive overhead leads to missed deadlines and poor course-match decisions.

The Solution

Edumentr consolidates the entire study-abroad journey into one intuitive mobile app — browsing 500+ partner universities across 6 countries, filtering by 9 parameters, reviewing eligibility requirements, uploading documents, and tracking live application status. Every screen is designed to reduce friction and surface only what a student needs at that moment.

Winelands Pass

Consumer Mobile App · iOS & Android · Published

RoleUX Consultant — Outsourced
PlatformiOS & Android
IndustryTravel · Lifestyle · Hospitality
Project TypeConsumer Mobile App
Discovery & Research

The Challenge

Wine region travellers had no single platform to discover, compare, and book curated experiences across the South African Winelands. Existing tools were fragmented, expensive, and lacked a savings mechanism for repeat visitors.

!No single platform for discovering Winelands experiences
!Bookings scattered across multiple websites and phone calls
!No cost-saving mechanism for regular wine region visitors
!Poor mobile experience for on-the-go travel decisions
!No personalised pass or digital ticket management

Objective

Design a premium, easy-to-use platform that helps users discover and book curated wine experiences, stays, and tastings — while offering cost-saving passes that make repeat visits more affordable and rewarding.

Design Goals

✓Intuitive experience discovery across categories
✓Pass-based savings clearly communicated at every step
✓Smooth, low-friction booking and checkout flow
✓Personal pass management with QR redemption
✓Premium visual identity matching the brand

What I Designed

Key Features

01
Experience Discovery

Category-based browsing across Tastings, Dining, Stay, Shopping, and Experiences — with smart search, location filters, and curated trending listings.

02
Pass-Based Savings

Day, Week, Month, and Year passes give upfront savings. WP price vs regular price is visible at every listing — value instantly communicated.

03
Social Sign-Up

Apple, Google, Facebook, and Email registration options — familiar authentication methods reduce sign-up friction on first open.

04
Smooth Booking Flow

3-step checkout: personal details → pass details → order summary. Minimal fields, progress indicator, and inline validation reduce drop-off.

05
Personal Pass Management

My PASSES shows the active QR code card with validity dates plus full order history — card design mirrors a physical premium membership.

06
Advanced Filtering

Multi-dimension filter panel — Cities, Event Type, Calendar, Discount %, Group Type — with live count badges and search within filters.

07
Place Detail & Reviews

Rich venue pages with photo carousels, WP savings callout, action bar (Call, Direction, Share, Review), amenities, and verified reviews.

08
Notifications Centre

Tiered alert system — Successful, Critical, Important, and General — with read/unread states, bulk select, and Mark all Read.

09
Onboarding & Education

3-screen carousel converts first-time visitors into pass buyers by educating on pass flexibility and booking freedom before they reach the home screen.

Outcomes

Design Impact

Discovery & Conversion

Category-led navigation paired with trending and new-offer sections reduced decision time. Clear WP savings labels at every listing accelerated pass purchase intent.

Booking Experience

A 3-step linear checkout with progress indicators and inline field validation created a frictionless purchase path — designed to minimise abandonment on mobile.

Brand & Retention

The QR-based PASS card, rich notification system, and native sharing integration combined to drive repeat engagement and organic word-of-mouth growth.

“Designing Winelands Pass meant balancing a premium lifestyle aesthetic with the practical needs of mobile travellers making time-sensitive booking decisions in wine country.”

Abhishek Patade — UX Consultant

Enterprise SaaS · Insurtech · Internal Tool

Digital1st CST Tracker

Majesco · Concept Wireframe · Oct 2018 – Dec 2021

RoleLead Product Designer
PlatformEnterprise Web SaaS
IndustryInsurtech · Professional Services
Project TypeInternal Concept Tool
Discovery & Research

The Problem

Majesco’s Digital1st delivery teams were tracking customer project health, resource utilisation, and financial performance across spreadsheets and disconnected systems. With 9+ active client implementations running in parallel, there was no single source of truth for revenue vs cost, capacity availability, or cross-account resource allocation.

!No unified view of revenue, cost, and gross margin across all active customer implementations
!Resource allocation tracked in spreadsheets — no visibility into over-commitment or availability gaps
!No standardised billing rate structure linked to resource grades and factory costs
!Project phase and customer data siloed — delivery leads lacked real-time project status tracking
!No pipeline visibility — upcoming resource needs vs current capacity unknown until too late

Objective

Design a purpose-built internal tracking platform for Majesco’s Digital1st Professional Services team — consolidating customer project tracking, resource allocation management, financial performance monitoring, and billing configuration into a single, decision-ready enterprise tool.

Design Goals

✓Single overview dashboard for revenue, cost & GM across all DBUs
✓6-month rolling resource allocation view per team member
✓Customer-project-phase hierarchy with inline date management
✓Factory cost master for grade-based billing rate governance
✓Quarterly financial projections vs actuals with YTD tracking

IA & Flows
Concept Design
Review

What I Designed

Key Modules

01
Executive Overview Dashboard

Annual revenue target progress bar, gross margin %, monthly revenue vs cost vs GM% bar/line chart, and DBU resource utilisation donut — designed for director-level decision-making.

02
DBU Financial Summaries

Quarterly P&L tables (Q1–Q4 actual, projection, and forecast) covering revenue by type (Implementation, Subscription, AMS), costs, and gross margin — with YoY comparison columns.

03
Customer & Phase Management

Customer hierarchy with project types and phase dates (Implementation, Subscription, AMS) managed through an inline Add Phase modal — clean, minimal, validation-aware.

04
All Resources View

Team profile cards with 6-month rolling % allocation by project — available capacity highlighted green, over-committed shown in red for instant capacity planning decisions.

05
Resource Allocation Grid

Per-customer editable allocation grid: inline % input fields per resource per month with real-time available delta — saves in bulk to avoid partial commitment errors.

06
Resources Summary

Cross-account role-based headcount matrix showing current total, joining pipeline, and open positions per engagement — surfacing staffing gaps before they become delivery risks.

07
Factory Cost Master

Admin-controlled grade-to-hourly-rate reference table (T1 to G16+) that drives gross margin calculations across all customer financial reports — editable by authorised roles only.

08
Projects Actual vs Budgeted

Per-project financial performance view comparing budgeted vs actual revenue and cost — enabling delivery teams to identify at-risk projects before end-of-quarter review cycles.

Outcomes

Design Impact

Core Modules
9+
Client Accounts Tracked

Source of Truth

Financial Visibility

Consolidating quarterly revenue, cost, and GM data into a single dashboard eliminated the director-level dependency on manual spreadsheet compilation — turning a weekly reporting task into a real-time self-service view.

Resource Planning Clarity

The 6-month rolling allocation grid with availability indicators gave delivery leads immediate visibility into over-committed and underutilised resources — a core input for proactive staffing decisions across 9+ client engagements.

Governance Foundation

The Factory Cost Master and grade-based billing structure provided a governed, single source of truth for all gross margin calculations — replacing ad-hoc rate estimates with an auditable, role-controlled reference table.

“Designing the CST Tracker was about transforming delivery chaos into structured intelligence — giving Majesco’s leadership a real-time window into the financial and operational health of every active implementation.”
